scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:backend && npm run postinstall --workspace=frontend && npm run db:push --workspace=backend && npm run db:seed --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:mobile
